## 3. H3c: role and label decodability at content tokens (D-inj test, 1547 items × 4 prompts; layer-0 invariant holds)

| Target @ position | Max AUROC | Layer of max | Mean over layers 1+ |

| role @ mean | 1.000 | 4 | 0.996 |
| label @ mean | 1.000 | 18 | 0.994 |
| role @ last | 1.000 | 35 | 0.992 |
| label @ last | 1.000 | 35 | 0.983 |

The design's reading: content tokens attend to the role tokens, so decodability does not rule out role information; it does not show that the model uses it.
